note: Inyo NF campground in Jeffrey pine about 2 miles from Mammoth Lakes, reached by 1.5 miles of two-lane gravel road; aspen-lined Sherwin Creek runs in a thicket just north of the loops, and a motocross track and off-road trails nearby draw OHV campers (see the host about OHV rules). Sites 001-015 are walk-to tent sites. Bear lockers at every site; Sherwin Lakes trailhead adjacent. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS page read: $32 confirmed (+$10 extra vehicle), reservable on rec.gov 14 nights, no hookups/no showers confirmed, vault + water, sites 87->85 (70 RV, 15 walk-to tent), 60 ft max kept, season 05-15..09-12 (2026); creekside -> not waterfront recommended (creek 55-100 m in a dense aspen thicket from the nearest RV sites); OHV-side flag.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'creekside' -> recommend 'not waterfront'. Sherwin Creek runs inside a dense aspen/willow thicket along the north edge of the campground. From the nearest RV sites (073 37.63166,-118.93633; 075 37.63168,-118.93659; 066-072 along the same edge) the ground is level for ~33 m, then drops into the thicket; 3DEP puts the channel floor at 57-100 m from site 075, under continuous riparian canopy - over the ~50 m bound and not over open ground. rec.gov photos of 069/072/073/075 show brush and aspen behind the pads, no creek. rec.gov says only that the loops are 'within walking distance of the creek'; the sites 'on either side of the creek' are the walk-to TENT loop (001-015), which a 23-ft rig can't use. There is no creek-view value. Replacement evidence: 'rec.gov catalog + Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-27: creek in a dense aspen thicket N of the loops, channel 57-100 m from nearest RV site 075; walk-to tent sites 001-015 are the creekside ones -> not waterfront'.

OHV (flag, not a drop): rec.gov 'With a motocross track and trails, Sherwin Creek is a hot spot for off-road vehicle enthusiasts' and 'Campers bringing off-road vehicles must see the campground host regarding rules.' A general family campground (85 sites, reservable) with an OHV side, not a staging camp - reads as a keep under the OHV rule.
PIN (~235 m, under 250 m): stored 37.62900,-118.93800 sits SW of the loops on a dirt patch. Suggest 37.63034,-118.93591 (centroid of the 85 rec.gov site points; FS page point 37.6301,-118.9357).
SITES: stored 87 -> 85 (FS '85 Campsites'; rec.gov catalog 85: 70 RV/trailer + 15 walk-to tent). 60 ft max kept (one site; most 35-40).

PHONE: stored 760-924-5500 is the Mammoth Lakes Welcome Center (FS page). The concession office is 760-934-5795 (rec.gov notice: 'Please call the office at 760-934-5795'). Either is defensible; suggest 760-934-5795 for campground questions.
ACCESS: rec.gov 'Access is via 1.5 miles on a two-lane gravel road' - no rig restriction; 60-ft spurs. Kept in the note.
FACILITIES: the old note's 'RV fill station' has no source on rec.gov or the FS page (amenities list vault toilets, water spigot only); dropped from the note.
STATUS: FS 'Site Closed' is the seasonal closure (season ended 09-12); no Inyo alert names Sherwin Creek. Operating left open.
